fr.sorbonne_u.devs_simulation.models.interfaces

Interface AtomicModelFactoryI

  • All Superinterfaces:
    java.io.Serializable
    All Known Subinterfaces:
    TicModelFactoryI
    All Known Implementing Classes:
    AbstractAtomicModelFactory, BasicCounterModelFactory, DependentCounterModelFactory, StandardAtomicHIOA_Factory, StandardAtomicModelFactory, StandardRTAtomicHIOA_Factory, StandardRTAtomicModelFactory

    public interface AtomicModelFactoryI
extends java.io.Serializable
    The interface AtomicModelFactoryI defines the shared behaviours among atomic model factories.

    Description

    An atomic model factory provides two principal methods, one that creates atomic models represented as instances of a given model representation class and another that creates a simulation engine instances of a given class that has been designed to run the atomic models created by this factory.

    When a programmer defines a type of atomic model, if he/she wants to use a creation of simulation architectures through their description as instances of ModelArchitecture, he/she will have the possibility to provide a factory implementing this interface.

    The protocol to use an atomic model factory first creates an instance of factory, then sets the creation parameters for the model, and then the method createAtomicModel can be called to create a model instance.

    Invariants

     invariant       true        // no more invariant

    Created on : 2018-06-21

    Author:
    Jacques Malenfant

      • setAtomicModelCreationParameters

        AtomicModelFactoryI setAtomicModelCreationParameters(java.lang.String modelURI,
                                                     java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit simulatedTimeUnit)
        set the creation parameters for an atomic model; implement a cascade pattern by returning this.

        Contract

         pre     !modelParametersSet()
 pre     modelURI != null && !modelURI.isEmpty()
 pre     simulatedTimeUnit != null
 post    modelParametersSet()
 post    return == this
        Parameters:
        modelURI - URI of the model to be created.
        simulatedTimeUnit - time unit used for the simulation clock.
        Returns:
        the same atomic model factory, implementing the cascading message pattern.
